title: Interactive Scenario Quiz - [YOUR TITLE HERE]
description: Learn by practicing real-world scenarios. Choose your response and get coaching feedback.

scenarios.customerSays: The objection, situation, or customer statement goes here. Make it realistic and specific.
scenarios.question: How do you respond?

options.text: Best response - Addresses concern, provides value, shows expertise
options.feedback: ✓ Excellent! You did X which shows Y. This approach builds trust because...

options.text: Good response - Helpful but missing something key
options.feedback: Good attempt! You addressed the concern, but you could strengthen this by... Next time, also consider...

options.text: Weak response - Dismissive, defensive, or incomplete
options.feedback: ⚠️ This approach misses the mark because... Instead, try focusing on... Remember, the customer's concern is valid even if...

options.text: Poor response - Counterproductive or makes things worse
options.feedback: ❌ Avoid this! This response devalues your solution and damages trust. Instead of dismissing concerns, address them with proof points like case studies, timelines, or ROI data.
Also excellent! Different approach, same strong result...

scenarios.customerSays: A challenging situation that tests judgment and empathy.
scenarios.question: What's your move?

options.feedback: Masterful! You stayed calm, validated their concern, and pivoted to solutions. This is exactly how to recover from mistakes or conflicts.
❌ Avoid this! When a customer is unhappy, validating their feeling first rebuilds trust. You can be right and still lose the deal if you're defensive.

masteryLevels.label: Elite 🏆
masteryLevels.description: You consistently choose strong responses and understand the nuances of real-world situations.

masteryLevels.label: Skilled 💼
masteryLevels.description: You handle most scenarios well. Focus on the scenarios where you scored lower for more refinement.

masteryLevels.label: Developing 📈
masteryLevels.description: You're building confidence. Review the scenarios you found challenging and practice the winning approaches.

masteryLevels.label: Keep Practicing 🎯
masteryLevels.description: Every response is a learning opportunity. Study the feedback carefully and retake the quiz to improve.
